thread:
Maya (CS): Quick idea — a tiny, consistent capture we can paste after customer calls. We're losing small asks across notes. Can we draft a 6-field snippet AEs/CS can drop into convo notes? :memo:
Evan (PM): Yes please. Suggest minimal fields: Customer, Use case, Pain, Impact, Suggested fix/workaround, Urgency (1-5). Keep it 1–2 lines. :+1:
Liam (CSE): Add 'Example API/prompt' (if it's product-facing) and 'Current workaround' — helps engineering triage.
Priya (Onboarding): Also include 'Onboarding stage' and 'Renewal flag' (yes/no) so CS can tag follow-ups.
Maya (CS): Nice — can someone turn that into a copy-paste snippet? I'd like AE to paste it directly into notes after calls.
Evan (PM): Yep. Two variants below: short single-line and a slightly expanded multiline for complex asks. Use whichever fits.
Evan (PM): ```
Cust: <org/name> | Stage: <trial/onboard/live> | Use case: <one-liner> | Pain: <one-liner> | Impact: <# users / blocks revenue / workflow> | Suggestion: <what they want> | Urgency: 1-5 | RenewalAtRisk: yes/no | Example: <prompt/api>
```
Liam (CSE): Multiline (for internal backlog): ```
Customer: <org/name>
Stage: <trial/onboard/live>
Use case: <short>
Pain: <short>
Impact: <est. scale / revenue / frequency>
Workaround: <how they cope today>
Suggested fix: <desired change>
Example request/prompt: <text>
Urgency: 1-5
Renewal risk: yes/no
Contact: <name/email>
```
Priya (Onboarding): Perfect. Can we add a one-liner to remind AEs to drop the customer's consent for feature contact? e.g., 'Can we follow up on this feature ask? yes/no'
Maya (CS): Added. Here's a final single-line template copy for notes (AE-friendly):
Maya (CS): ```
Cust: <org> | Stage: <trial/onboard/live> | Use case: <one-liner> | Pain: <one-liner> | Impact: <est scale/revenue> | Suggestion: <brief> | Urgency: <1-5> | FollowUp: yes/no | RenewalRisk: yes/no | Contact: <name/email>
```
Evan (PM): I'll wire this into the shared feedback spreadsheet and add a tiny zap to create a row when AE pastes it into the CS note field (low-effort).
feedback-bot: Created feedback capture template — link: https://redwood.internal/feedback-clipboard (internal)
Liam (CSE): Sweet. For engineering triage, can we agree on tagging priority: P0/P1/P2 in the spreadsheet? Keeps the backlog sane.
Priya (Onboarding): Agreed — CS will mark RenewalRisk and set priority if it looks renewal-impacting.
Maya (CS): Thanks all — I'll post the single-line template to the CS playbook and ping AEs to start using it this week. :rocket:
Evan (PM): :thumbsup: I'll add a column mapping (product area, estimated effort) so we can run quick prioritization next week.
Maya (CS): Filing this thread as the source for the rollout notes. If anyone wants changes, speak now or DM.
